subject: Ignite Series: joint invite copy, staffing & MDF split
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura@ignitelabs.io>, Miguel Torres <m.torres@partnerco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ignite Series: joint invite copy, staffing & MDF split

Hi Laura / Miguel —

Great to meet you both last week. Ignite Labs and PartnerCo feel like a natural fit for a co-hosted mini-series aimed at product and infra teams that evaluate inference stacks. I drafted a short playbook (attached) with a proposed 3-part mini-webinar sequence plus a single-market booth presence at the West Coast Inference Summit in September.

Two asks to move forward:
1) Can you confirm audience target & funnel (product leads vs. SRE/infra)? We propose product+platform as primary (~60/40).
2) MDF and ops: we attached an outline and a suggested staffing roster. Can you confirm whether Ignite Labs is comfortable with a 50/50 MDF split for paid ads/promoted invites, and whether you can cover booth logistics locally?

Proposed high-level timeline:
- June: finalize invite copy + landing page
- July: promotional push (ads + joint email)
- Aug: rehearsal/workshop for speakers
- Sept: Summit booth + follow-up nurture

Attachments: Ignite_Series_Outline_v2.pdf, Staffing_Roster.xlsx

If that looks reasonable, would you be available for a 30-min sync next week (Mon/Tue preferred) to lock dates and staffing? Marissa and Ben are copied for ops and MDF coordination.

Thanks —

Sofia Ivanova
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com

From: Laura Chen <laura@ignitelabs.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Miguel Torres <m.torres@partnerco.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ignite Series: joint invite copy, staffing & MDF split

Hi Sofia —

Thanks — excited by the concept. A couple quick clarifying points:
- Audience: we can commit to product managers + platform engineers, but our lists skew slightly toward product. If Redwood can take a larger portion of the SRE targeting that's fine.
- MDF: 50/50 on paid promotion is reasonable, but Ignite would need RD to own creative production and landing page dev. We can fund some localized paid social.
- Summit booth: we can cover two local staff heads; if Redwood can supplement with one product person and one solutions engineer, that would be perfect.

Dates: we prefer the first webinar week of Aug (Aug 3-7) and the Summit is best for us Sept 14-16.

I'll loop in our events lead if we decide to proceed — Miguel is copied and will handle internal approval for MDF. Could you share a short PO/scope for internal review?

Best,
Laura Chen
Head of Growth | Ignite Labs
laura@ignitelabs.io

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura@ignitelabs.io>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ignite Series: joint invite copy, staffing & MDF split

Thanks Laura — and thanks Sofia for the heads-up. Quick operational notes from MDF/field ops: 

- MDF: Redwood can own creative (landing page, invite copy, 2 ad variants) and split media spend 50/50. We can also offer a co-branded content production credit of $4,000 to cover speaker prep and editing if Ignite commits to the 50% paid contribution.
- PO/contract: we'll need a simple SOW and PO referencing the event dates + deliverables (ads, landing page, two webinars, Summit booth). I can draft a one-page SOW for review by Monday.
- Staffing: attached roster indicates Redwood can supply 1 product rep + 1 solutions engineer on-site for the Summit; that matches Laura's ask. For webinars, we recommend 2 hosts/moderators total (one from each org) and one producer (Redwood).

Next steps I propose:
1) Sofia/Laura confirm target date for the first webinar (Aug 4 preferred).
2) I’ll circulate a draft SOW + PO template by Mon (link to DocSend in related_links).
3) Marissa, can you book a 30-min planning slot for next Tue?

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura@ignitelabs.io>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Miguel Torres <m.torres@partnerco.com>
Date: Sat, 06 Jun 2026 15:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ignite Series: joint invite copy, staffing & MDF split

Laura / team —

Perfect, thanks for the quick replies. Agreed on the high-level approach: Redwood will take creative ownership, we’ll split paid 50/50, and Redwood will provide the additional on-site staff for the Summit as outlined.

I’ve booked a 30-minute planning slot for next Tue 2026-06-09 at 10:00 PT to finalize the SOW and confirm the Aug 4 webinar date (calendar invite sent). Action items:
- Ben: draft SOW + PO (due Mon 06/08).
- Marissa: build co-branded landing page skeleton and prep initial invite copy (share Drive link).
- Laura / Miguel: confirm internal MDF approval and share Ignite events lead contact.
- Grace: add Summit travel checklist to Staffing_Roster.xlsx and confirm hardware needs for booth.

Sofia Ivanova
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
